notes: Murrow: asteroid-colony diggers, mole-folk, on THE LARGE RIG: the frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24) (the normal 2x2 body, 32 px, sits at the centre, its shadow and pathing stay there; the art overhangs it). Mounts and hands are the shared targets moved by (+8,+8), identical relative to the pivot, so every item fits (item top-left = mount - item.grip). Dark velvet fur caked with tan dust on a stocky hunched barrel of a body, a small head with a long snout ending in a pink star-nose and tiny eyes, and HUGE digging claws: pink palms with three long cream spade claws (spread wide when unarmed, a smaller grip round an item). A miner's harness (crossed straps, belt with a brass buckle), an ore sack on the back, a lamp battery on the hip, a pick stowed on the right, a short bare tail in the legs layer (it swings with the walk). head_glow (2 frames per head, ~3 fps) is the headlamp of the lamp and helmet heads; torso_glow the battery lamp. Head variants: snout, lamp (a tinted headband with a lamp), helmet (a dented hard hat, tinted, with a lamp). Outfit mask = the harness straps, belt, wrist wraps, headband and hard hat. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND large: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 3 fps
